serverInfo.name: texuli
serverInfo.title: Texuli MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Every Texuli operation as an MCP tool: search the component catalog, read manifests and examples, validate manifests and blueprints, search, read and preview themes, and run deck and document commands. Local over stdio (npx -y @texuli/mcp, every operation) or remote over Streamable HTTP (https://texuli.com/mcp, the edge operations). Read-only: nothing is stored, fetched or modified.

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.title: Search the component catalog
tools.description: Search the built, content-addressed Texuli component catalog by text, group and emit tier. Returns the catalog hash and file name, the match count and one summary per component (id, package, label, summary, tier, group, emit tiers).

tools.name: catalog.validate
tools.title: Validate catalog manifests
tools.description: Validate one candidate catalog manifest, or a set (which also catches duplicate ids), without writing files. Returns valid and a list of diagnostics, each with a code, a JSONPath, a message and a hint.

tools.name: component.get
tools.title: Read a component manifest
tools.description: Read one component manifest from the catalog: its props with kinds and schemas, events, examples, useWhen and dontUseWhen guidance, accessibility notes and the emit tiers that may place it.

tools.name: example.search
tools.title: Find component examples
tools.description: Find worked manifest examples (props an agent can copy) by component id and/or example id, or search their titles and descriptions. Returns the match count and each example with its component id and package.

tools.name: blueprint.validate
tools.title: Validate a blueprint draft
tools.description: Validate a blueprint draft (a catalog tree, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope, migrated first) with the catalog's draft checks: structure, sinks, tree limits, component ids, tiers and prop schemas, deep block and document schemas, grammar and the frame root. Returns valid, status, tier, migratedFrom and diagnostics with the catalog's stable codes.

tools.name: theme.search
tools.title: Search the theme library
tools.description: Search the Texuli theme library (200+ offline themes) by words, category, collection, mood or tag. Returns the match count and each theme’s metadata: id, name, description, category, collection, mood, tags, contrast level and whether it is dark-first.

tools.name: theme.get
tools.title: Read a full theme
tools.description: Read the full token definition of one library theme: its id, name and every light and dark color, radius, font and chart token, ready to compile or apply.

tools.name: theme.preview
tools.title: Preview a theme
tools.description: Preview one library theme in light or dark mode: its key tokens (background, foreground, primary, border, radius, font …) and the WCAG 2.x AA contrast report for both modes, with issue counts.

tools.name: deck.run
tools.title: Run a deck command
tools.description: Inspect, lint and convert a Texuli deck on the shared v2 model: capabilities, the JSON Schema, layouts, lint, inspect, from-markdown and to-markdown. Pure compute; returns { result } with the command output (ok, issues, deck, markdown …).

tools.name: document.run
tools.title: Run a document command
tools.description: Create, validate, inspect, patch and convert a Texuli document (spec 0.7.0): capabilities, the JSON Schema, validate, inspect, a bounded RFC 6902 patch (at most 1000 operations), from-markdown, to-markdown and to-blueprint. Returns { result } with the command output; PDF and DOCX are document.export.

tools.name: document.export
tools.title: Export a document as PDF or DOCX
tools.description: Write a Texuli document as PDF or DOCX bytes with the owned writers, links and media checked at the tier. Returns { result } with ok, mime, byteLength, base64 bytes (no files are written), diagnostics and, for PDF, pageCount. Needs Node.
